items.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

items.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
items.summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

items.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
items.summary: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

items.title: هوش مصنوعی امنیتی GPT-6 Cyber رونمایی شد؛ قدرتمند و «خطرناک»

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

items.title: چرخش بزرگ کوالکام از بازار موبایل به دیتاسنترهای هوش مصنوعی
items.summary: افت ۲۰ درصدی فروش گوشی، کوالکام را به بازاری کشانده است که می‌تواند تا سال ۲۰۲۹ درآمدی ۱۵ میلیارد دلاری ایجاد کند.

items.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
items.summary: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.
